mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees with moderate rain near Verona Area High School, and we are under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Police Department has compiled a report of noteworthy calls between August 31 and September 14, highlighting various incidents ranging from traffic violations and arrests to a bizarre viral prank involving cheese on windshields.

There is plenty to do in town with trivia happening today at Hop Haus Brewing Company and Lake Lou-ee, followed by tomorrow's lineup featuring yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.

One notable event from the police report occurred on September 5, when officers investigated multiple reports of cheese being placed on car windshields as part of a viral social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
Our local Culver's is currently closed, but the staff will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM with today's flavor of the day.
